data.text: Good to see everyone. My family taught me to fish here, and I want this lake to keep supporting our village. With 100 tons in the lake, we can catch 50 tons total and leave 50 to double back to 100 next month. How about we each take 10 tons this month? That’s $10,000 apiece, and we can keep earning that every month if we stick to the limit. Let’s check our catches together afterward and agree on next month’s plan. John, does that sound fair to you?
